segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers mostly report good results, saying the cleanser removes blackheads and mascara without leaving residue or increasing oil, though some acne-prone/oily reviewers report new breakouts.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers describe the cleanser as hydrating and non-stripping, with several saying their face feels softer and less dry than after other cleansers.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including those with an oily T-zone, report it balances dry and oily patches without clogging pores.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers largely say it is gentle and non-irritating, though a few sensitive/reactive users report stinging, burning, or a strong scent that is hard to tolerate.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 60s with dry-combination skin reports repeated repurchase and good performance across seasons for makeup and SPF removal.
segments.normal: Reviewers who do not specify a particular skin type mostly describe the cleanser as soft, hydrating, and non-greasy after rinsing.

concerns.aging: One mature reviewer with dry-combination skin reports consistent satisfaction and repurchase; no reviewer reports negative effects on fine lines or firmness.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers, including dry and sensitive skin, report the cleanser leaves skin hydrated and not tight or stripped; one reviewer notes no noticeable hydration boost beyond a normal cleanse.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers mention stinging near the eyes or skin starting to burn after continued use, though most reviewers report no irritation or redness.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers say the product keeps their skin barrier calm or stronger over time; one reviewer specifically avoided it after suspecting it caused nightly burning tied to barrier disruption.
concerns.spots: Reviewers focused on blackheads and sebaceous filaments report visible improvement on the nose, though one reviewer says it only removes a few impurities per use and leaves most blackheads untouched.
concerns.blemishes: Many acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and even fewer flare-ups over time; several others explicitly report new bumps, cystic-like breakouts around the mouth and cheeks, or breakouts starting after a week or two of use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers frequently report the cleanser does not leave a greasy residue and controls shine after rinsing, but a few reviewers describe the product itself as too greasy or oily-feeling on the skin.
